title: The wheel and the estimate
hook: Two stated cases: explore the arbitrary starting point with fixed evidence.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the arbitrary starting point with fixed evidence affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Estimate, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the arbitrary starting point with fixed evidence in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
